changes.description: The Tinuë Solver's Analyze Position and interactive mode now check whether the side to move is lost on any position, not only after a tinuë.
A lost position in the Tinuë Solver lists the three defenses that hold out longest, each with the line that beats it.
The Tinuë Solver's "No strict tinuë" verdict now reads "No tak-chain tinuë".
The Tinuë Solver no longer has an Edit Engine dialog, which held only evaluation mark thresholds it never used.
